The repo ships only a placeholder. So QGIS serving requires user-provided project. Is this a failure? The guide documents QGIS Server as an access point. A valid QGIS project is user data (documentation of passive networks) — not something installation should create. The installation summary notes this as incomplete/unknown.

The dev compose is the documented Method 2. The guide's Quick Start uses production compose. But the dev compose is a valid documented alternative? Let me check the deployment README to see if dev is documented as method 2.
